title: Bi-allelic variants in CDK20 cause a severe ciliopathy with midline brain and facial anomalies.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Ran paper_context.py: no Europe PMC full text, no supplement listing, no text-mined accessions, no Zenodo/Dryad hits. NCBI lists a PMC link (13504332) but Europe PMC flags show no open full text or data.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Cohort size (7 individuals, 5 families), the variant c.687+6T>C, and fibroblast cilium/Hedgehog assays all come from the abstract only.

a1_downloadable.note: No deposited dataset found; patient-level genetic data in rare-disease case reports is typically controlled or not shared. Checked via paper_context only.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: No table exists; any label (variant pathogenic or not, phenotype) would have to be built from case descriptions.

a4_units_stated.note: No quantitative table found to check.

a5_enough_rows.note: Abstract reports 7 affected individuals from 5 families; far under the 400-row classification minimum.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: No download to compare against the paper.

a8_label_provenance.note: Phenotypes and immunoblot/cilium assays are clinical and lab measurements, not model outputs (from abstract).

honest_claim_h3: None: a seven-patient gene-discovery case series supports no ML claim on its own.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use a patient's gene variants and features to predict whether they have this new CDK20-linked brain and face ciliopathy.
plain_idea.train_on: Genetic variants and clinical features of affected individuals; only 7 exist (from the abstract), and no data file was found.
plain_idea.predict: Disease diagnosis or variant pathogenicity, with truth from clinical genetics review in the paper.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Would help clinical geneticists diagnose rare ciliopathies, but 7 cases cannot train or test a model.

label_elsewhere.sources: Not assessed (reject); CDK20 variant classifications might later appear in ClinVar (known resource, not checked).
label_elsewhere.why: Not assessed because the project failed Part A.

ml_idea: None viable; at most the 7 CDK20 cases could be a handful of test examples for an existing variant-effect predictor.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated; no dataset exists to model.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Count of individuals: 7 per abstract, already fatal.

verdict_reason: Rare-disease case report: seven patients, no deposited dataset or label table (fails A1, A2, A5).
